title: Fraine Supermarket
summary: A supermarket app rebuilt so pickup and delivery come first. iOS and Android from one codebase, across five branches.
problem: A supermarket with five branches had an app that read like a catalogue. Customers weren't using it for pickup or delivery.
approach: Complete redesign and rebuild on one codebase for both platforms, with a motion-led interface and pickup and delivery treated as the primary flows rather than an afterthought.
highlights: Full redesign and rebuild for iOS and Android from a single codebase.
Pickup and delivery built as first-class flows.
